tei:div.tei:p: $!#$&"$ ༄༅// rtsa gsum bka' srung bcas kyi gtor bsngos bzhugs so//

shrī ma na gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la ye na ma: 'dir phyi dro'i cha la bya ba'i gtor bsngos kyi rim pa zhal rgyun ji lta bar bkod pa la/ mdun bskyed kyi rten thang sku sogs yod na gal che zhing*/ gtor ma'i rdzas gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba ci 'byor bshams la/ bdag mdun dus gcig la ma mgon zhal sbyor du sgom dgos te/ de'ang bdag bskyed la mgon por lha mos 'khyud pa dang*/ mdun bskyed lha mo la mgon po phar 'khyud pa'i khyad tsam la gnyis ka mngon rtogs dang mthun par bskyed/ bdag mdun gnyis ka la dbugs len yab yum bcu drug gis bskor ba gtso che/ 'khor gzhan gsal na legs kyang de tsam ma byung na'ang mos pa tsam gyis chog /thog mar bla ma brgyud rim la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bde chen rdo rje'i bdag nyid he ru ka /dngos kyi go 'phang mchog grub ar+ṇa pa// de yis rjes bzung mal lo blo gros grags// de sras gnyal pa sūr+ya dz+wā la dang*// gnyal pa jo sras gru gu ras chen pa// rgyal ba'i sras po bsod nams rdo rje'i zhabs// mthu stobs dbang phyug grub chen pak+shi sogs// yab rkyang brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhang btsun dar ma'i mtshan// khyung po stag sham rgyal ba ye shes dang*// bla chen mgon po stong dpon shes rab mgon// mtshur phu pa sogs yum rkyang brgyud par 'dud// slob dpon pad+ma nam mkha'i lha gzungs dang*// sngags 'chang mi rabs bcu gsum sogs kyi mthar// grub chen chos kyi bla ma la sogs pa// zhal sbyor brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la 'dud// rdo rje 'chang chen tai lo nā ro pa// mar pa mi la dwags po dus mkhyen zhabs// ras chen zhabs sogs lho brag mgon po zhes// rdzogs rim rlung bsre'i brgyud pa rnams la 'dud// bka' bab kun 'dus chos kyi bla ma nas// saṅga lak+ṣa rang byung rgyal ba'i zhabs// mgon po rgyal mtshan rol pa'i rdo rje dang*// grags pa seṅge dar ma rgyal mtshan pa// mkha' spyod dbang po kun dga' blo gros dang*// rin chen bzang po chos kyi bzang po dang*// mthong ba don ldan ban sgar 'jam dpal bzang*// rang byung mtsho skyes 'dan ma grub chen dang*// mi bskyod rdo rje dkon mchog yan lag dang*// dbang phyug rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug dang*// karma chags med dul mo chos kyi rje// chos kyi don grub bstan pa'i nyin byed zhabs// bdud 'dul rdo rje chos grub rgya mtsho'i sde'i// pad+ma nyin byed theg mchog rdo rje 'chang*// blo gros mtha' yas don kun lhun gyis grub// mkha' khyab rdo rje pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal// mkhyen brtse 'od zer rig pa'i rdo rje sogs// mi phyed dad pas snying gi ti la kar// 'bral med bsnyen nas rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs// de yi mthu las bde dbang ye shes mgon// bdag sgrub la brten rlung bsre'i man ngag gis// mchog gi dngos grub myur du 'grub pa dang*// sku mgon dkar pos tshe yi dngos grub dang*// yon tan mgon pos longs spyod 'phel ba dang*// gsung mgon dmar pos snang srid dbang du sdud// phrin las mgon pos dgra bgegs tshar gcod cing*// thugs mgon mthing gas mngon shes 'grub gyur cig

/yab rkyang las mgon sras mchog nag po yi// sgrub pa mthar phyin phyi sgrub par bu dang*// nang sgrub dza rdung gsang sgrub rnam gnyis la// brten nas bstan pa srung ba'i nus thob shog /'jig rten mgon po dregs pa yab yum la// brten nas ma mgon drag po'i par nag dang*// dregs pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis par bur bcas// ging bdud dmar nag he lam 'bar ma sogs// mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las thogs med du// 'grub pas ma rungs bstan dgra gdug pa can// rgyab rten gnod byed dam sri dpung dang bcas// ming rus rjes shul med par brlag gyur cig /mdor na yongs 'dzin dpal ldan karma pa// yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// chos skyong rdo rje nag po lcam dral bcas// dbyer med mchog gi go 'phang 'grub gyur cig / 'di man rje bcu drug pa'i gsung*/ mchan/ chos sku'i bdag nyid mgon po 'od dpag med// longs sku'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// ye shes sku brnyes gu ru pad+ma 'byung*// ngo bo gcig bsdus dpal ldan karma pa// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ces tsha ko ba bla ma bstan rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas phrin las kun khyab ye shes dpal bzang pos spel ba'o// ༈ oṃ daṃ ḍ+ḍo t+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya saṃ saṃ saṃ ru ru ru hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhā:sarba dharmā:swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las brag steng dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus// bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang*// 'khor lo bzhi rim lte bar pad nyi la// ti las rdzu 'phrul drel rta'i gdan gyi steng*// ma las lha mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma// kha ṭ+wāṃ phur pa me long sbrul zhags bsnams// btsan stabs 'khyil ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i pang*// hūm̐ las mgon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// mthing nag spyan gsum ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs// dbu skra gyen brdzes g.yas pas gri gug dang*// g.yon gyi thod khrag thod skam dbu rgyan can// dug sbrul rus pa sna tshogs dar gyis brgyan// dar nag 'jol ber stag gi sham thabs dang*// mgo phreng do shal zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i gar// g.yon pas yum la 'khril tshul 'jigs pa'i gzugs// khams gsum dbang sdud zil gnon chen por gyur// 'khor lo dang por 'gugs byed snying khrag 'thung*// dbugs len srog bdag dur khrod 'joms byed dang*// kha lo sgyur byed gdug 'dul sreg byed de// rang 'dra'i yum can gtso bo lta bu'o// gnyis par dpal 'bar 'chang dang rnam thos sras// dbang phyug 'bar ba legs ldan dzam+bha la// shugs ldan dam can gtsug gtor ljang lha mgon// brtan ma cha lugs gzhon pa sna tshogs can// gsum par dbang phyug srin po bdud gshin rje// dga' bo khyab 'jug bgegs rgyal traka shad de// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can rang 'dra brgyad res bskor// bzhi par spyang zhon ma bdun sring mo bzhi// phur bu ma bdun nang gi 'bar ba bzhi// zangs ral ma bdun phyi rim 'bar ma bzhi// mtshon 'khor ma bdun dus kyi lha mo bzhi// ma bdun sring bdun mdza' bdun bran mo bdun// de yi phyi rol mche gtsigs las mkhan ma// mchu 'jib kha 'gal rigs mthun 'khor gyis bskor// kun gyi spyi bor oṃ yig dkar po dang*// mgrin par āḥdamar thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po// mgon po'i thugs kar zla bar hūm̐ mthing nag

/lha mo'i thugs kar nyi mar bh+yo sngon po// sa bon rnams las 'od 'phros byang phyogs nas// ye shes mgon po sangs rgyas byang chub sems// 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar gshegs par gyur// 'dun pa brtan pas spyan 'dren gyi sngags brjod cing sa bon rnams kyi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ ri rab kyi rtse mo nas ma mgon 'khor bcas char bab pa ltar byon nas bdag mdun bar gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam la/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// dpal ldan mgon po spyan 'dren na// thugs rje'i thugs dam dbang gis ni// bstan pa srung phyir gshegs su gsol/ hūm̐/ mgon po'i thugs dam bskang ba dang*// gzhan gyi gnod pa bzlog pa dang*// bdag gi las rnams sgrub phyir dang*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung slad du// mgon po nag po spyan 'dren na// 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings nyid nas// lha chen dpal 'bar spyan 'dren gyi// nag po chen po gshegs su gsol/ hūm̐/ gtum chen drag por khros pa'i srin po'i gzugs// nag po mi bzad ma hā kā la ni// dad pa dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren na// thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ bh+yo/ byang shar chos dbyings pho brang nas// bstan pa bsrung phyir sku sprul pa// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs ma tshur gshegs// dam tshig dbang gis myur du byon// yongs 'du'i shing la brten bcas shing*// rdzu 'phrul myur mgyogs drel la zhon// dur khrod nyul shing 'dzam gling bskor// mgyogs byed chen mo gshegs su gsol// khrag 'thung ma mo'i dkyil 'khor nas// skye 'gro yongs kyi dbugs len ma// sha la dga' shing khrag la rngams// za byed chen mo gshegs su gsol// nag mo mi bzad ral pa can// sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas// sprul pa'i ma mos stong khams khyab// rdzu 'phrul chen mo gshegs su gsol// grangs med bskal pa'i sngon rol nas// sa brgyad non pa'i sems ma khyod// mi sdug gzugs 'chang srin mo'i tshul// 'jig byed chen po gshegs su gsol/

hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// dbang po me lha gshin rje dang*// bden bral chu bdag rlung gi lha// gnod sbyin dbang ldan tshangs pa dang*// nyi zla gza' skar sa bdag sogs// biṣ+ṇu ma mo gshin rje dang*// srin po ro langs gsod byed tshogs// klu dang bdud mo 'byung po rnams// gtum drag 'jig rten pho nya'i tshogs// rang rang gnas nas 'dir dgongs la// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā la kā lā ya/ de wa rak+ṣa/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ 'dir shog 'dir shog /ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya/ hūm̐ ya dzaḥhūm̐ ya dzaḥ oṃ ma hā kā li/ trag rak+ṣa tiṃ laṃ sa ma ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ nag mo tiṃ laṃ ma ma dun bh+yo/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ kā li dun bh+yo: e ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ma ti ma hā sa ma ya/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ ma ma pa sha ra/ sha kā la/ sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ a la la hoḥ ma mo nag mo tiṃ laṃ/ ma mo nag mo dun tiṃ bh+yo/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ nag mo dun bh+yo/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sa ma ya/ e h+ye hi dzaḥ ā ral+li hoḥ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ zhes brjod pas sprin gyi phung po lta bur mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam/ oṃ/ khrag gi rgya mtsho me tog u pāk+ṣa// tshil chen bsreg dang mar nag chen po'i me// thal chen khrag zhag bdud rtsi sha chen lnga// dur khrod sgra yis phyogs rnams bkang ste 'bul// oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la de wī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur// gdan 'bul zhing bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ gtum po 'jigs su rung ba srin po'i gzugs// byang chub sems dpa' dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad pa// srin po nag po mi pham khro gnyer can// dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol// brag ri pad+ma nyi ma ro yi gdan// mdung dang ral gri gshibs pa'i gzhal yas su// srin po'i gzugs can nag po chen po ni// phyag 'tshal mchod phyir gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol// byang shar pho brang mdzes pa na// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du// bam chen zhing mchog bsnol ba la// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// rak+mo rak+ṣa ma hi ku la pad+ma sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/

e h+ya hi sa ma ya hūm̐/ hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar// byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'dir ni// drag po 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// mnyam pa'i thal mo/ srin mdzub nang du bsnol ba'i rtse mo/ mtheb mdzub sbyar ba'i nang du bcug cing*/ srin mdzub g.yas pa thod rlon gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ ma hā kā li trag rak+ṣa thun bh+yo sa ma ya/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la ya/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra ya/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma ti/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las rdo rje lcags kyu'i gzugs can gyi 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang*/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ khro bo dang*/ khro mo'i tshogs rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs rnams dang*// khrag 'thung dpal dang lha mo rnams// rdo rje khro bo khro mo'i tshogs// ji snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhiṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bgegs bskrad pa dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin spro ba dang*/ bkra shis brjod pa dang*/ dgongs pa mdzad pa dang*/ rig pa'i lha mo brgyad rnams kyis bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ kā la sha a bhi ṣe ka ta hūm̐/ oṃ shu n+ya tā tiṣ+ṭha te swā hā/ zhes gsungs bzhin pas bde ba chen por bum pa/ mgrin par gsang ba/ snying gar shes rab ye shes/ lte bar bzhi pa ste/ de ltar dbang bskur bas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa dang*/ gla rtsi dang dri zhim po yongs su rdzogs par 'dzin pa dang*/

sred med kyi bu la sogs pas byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ lha rnams thams cad kyi dam tshig gis skyong zhing mi gtong bar gyur pa'o// slar yang dbang gi lha rnams gcig tu gyur pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can gyi bla mas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de yang bdag bskyed la karma pak+shis dbu brgyan/ mdun bskyed la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ rang tha mal pa grangs med spros nas bdag mdun la phyag 'tshal bar dmigs la/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings las khro bo'i skur ston pa// chos nyid ngang las ma g.yos bstan srung tshul// rdo rje gtum po'i thugs las rab sprul pa// ye shes mgon po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i don du thugs rje'i skur sprul zhing*// sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs 'dul// nag po mi bzad khro gnyer ral pa can// sras mchog nag po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// gsang sngags rnal 'byor kun gyi bka' srung mdzad// sangs rgyas bstan srung phas kyi rgol ba bzlog /gtum po bdud 'dul dregs pa sha za'i gzugs// 'jig rten mgon po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// bh+yo/ mkhal la dbang bsgyur yid bzhin sprul pa'i sku// ya mtshan rmad byung lus la til mar byugs// dbang phyug nag mo gsang ba'i re ma ti// nag mo stong gi gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ ma hā kā la kā la ye na ma/ oṃ daṃ ṣ+ṭot+ka ṭa sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod par hūm̐ yig nag po las// mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo la sogs mchod pa'i sprin// rab 'byams snang stong lha rnams mnyes byed gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ/ khrag gi rgya mtsho me tog u pāk+ṣa// tshil chen bsreg dang mar nag chen po'i me// thal chen khrag zhag bdud rtsi sha chen lnga// dur khrod sgra yis phyogs rnams bkang ste 'bul/

/oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la de wī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ skabs gsum grong gis mtshan pa'i lhun po dang*// lus can yo byad rdzogs pa'i gling rnams dang*// rin chen sa 'dzin rnams dang bdud rtsi'i mtsho// dag byed mu khyud phyogs rnams bkang ste 'bul// oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la de wī sa pa ri wā ra rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ /

gtor ma'i rdzas bdud rtsi'i chus bsang zhing*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmā:swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ chang zung la yam̐ dang*/ mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las thod pa bum ril gyi sgyed bu ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyi steng du/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍūr+ya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rak+ta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta'i sha /de rnams slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /ba dan bskyod pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing*/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes gtor mgron spyan drangs/ pad skor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/

dṛ sh+ya hoḥ lan gsum/ na mo rat+na gu ru i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi kha hi/ lan gsum/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ chos sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ tai lo shes rab bzang po/ nā ro dz+nyā na sid+dhi/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras pa chen po/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ grub chen karma pak+shi/ mkhas grub o rgyan pa/ sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje/ rgyal ba g.yung ston chen po/ dzam gling chos kyi grags pa/ rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ rje btsun rat+na bha dra/ sprul sku mthong ba don ldan/ kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho/ grub chen bkra shis dpal 'byor/ mtshungs med mi bskyod rdo rje/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag /rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje/ gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug /rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje/ dpal ldan ye shes snying po/ mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas/ rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje/ mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho/ pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ theg pa mchog gi rdo rje/ rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas/ kun bzang mkha' khyab rdo rje/ pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po/ dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer/ khyab bdag rig pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/

slob dpon chen po ḍom+bhi pa/ mal gyo lo tsā ba/ gnyal pa nyi ma 'bar/ gnyal pa gyo sras/ 'gro mgon ras chen/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ chos rje karma pa/ bla ma gnyan ras/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ mgon po rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje/ rtogs ldan grags pa seng ge /dar ma rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang po/ kun dga' blo gros/ bla ma rin po che rat+na bha dra/ chos kyi bzang po/ sprul pa'i sku dharma shrī dz+nyā na/ la sogs pa drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha wa/ pu rang ba zhang btsun dar ma rin chen/ gtsang la stod kyi khyung po stag sham can/ skyu ra rgyal ba'i ye shes/ phyag bla chen mgon po/ stong dpon shes rab mgon po/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pa drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra bar+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs kyis bde mchog yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'o// oṃ de wa bi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs kyis kyai rdor dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhū ma gha ye na maḥswā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ dzaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs kyi rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs kyis gsang 'dus dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs kyis gdan bzhi dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ h+h+k+ṣ+m+l+w+r+yoḥm̐ shrī kā la tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs kyis dus 'khor dang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs kyis gshed dmar dang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī wi kṛ tā naṃ na hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs kyis dgra nag 'jigs byed dang*/ oṃ h+ya gṝ wa pad+ma kro dhī shwa ri badz+ra pā ṇi badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā kā la yak+ṣa ya mān+ta kṛt+ka la rū pa karma ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ khroṃ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dang*// 'khor gyi dregs pa pho mo'i tshogs// 'khor dang g.yog tu bcas pa la// bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags na// 'dod don ma lus sgrub tu gsol// i daṃ ba liṃ te dzo ba liṃ ba la ba ti sa ma ye hūm̐/ hūm̐/ khor yug bcas pa'i bhan+dha chen po ru// rgyu drug rtog pa'i rang bzhin rnam par dag /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i// sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud rnams tshim gyur cig /a la la hoḥbazhes te dgyes par rol// gyis rta mgrin bder 'dus pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ duṣ+ṭa na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs kyis phyag rdor gtum po dang*/ yi dam bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/

sogs kyis yi dam spyi la phul nas/ sku gsung thugs shin tu mnyes nas bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma dang phyogs skyong sogs la/ badz+ra ḍā ki ni/ bud+dha ḍā ki nī/ rat+na ḍā ki nī/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī/ karma ḍā ki nī/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī/ lo ka ḍā ki nī/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pad+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhu ta pre ta pi shā tsi un mā da a pa smā ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gh+rih+nan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu ya thai baṃ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ bhuñdza tha dzi gha tha pi ba tha mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā rā ta ya sa t+su khaṃ bhi shud+dha ye/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ haṃ haṃ he he hi hi pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes pas gtor ma phul te/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis sogs// ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir byon zhing*// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces 'dod don gsol lo/ /de nas gtor ma la bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/

oṃ daṃṣ+ko t+ka ṭa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong par gyur pa'i ngang nyid las// yam̐ las rlung dang de yi steng*// raṃ las me 'bar phyogs gsum dang*// kaṃ las thod sgyed de yi steng*// a las thod pa'i nang du ni// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su mu// shar du bi dang byang du ma// nub tu shu dang lho ru ra// de rnams las skyes bdud rtsi lnga// slar yang dbus su na yig dang*// shar lhor go dang lho nub tu// ku dang rlung du da yig dang*// byang shar ha las sha lnga ste// ming gi yi ges rgyas btab pa'o// steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la// rdo rje gri gug 'bar ba ni// lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las// 'od 'phros 'og gi phyogs song bas// rlung gis me sbar thod pa dros// rdzas rnams dam tshig bdud rtsi ste// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin no// slar yang steng du 'od 'phros pas// ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas// thod pa'i nang du zhugs gyur pa// gri gug gis dkrugs gnyis med gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i dbyibs dang*/ dpal mgon po 'khor bcas kyi ljags gri gug gi dbyibs dang*/ dpal lha mo 'khor bcas kyi ljags kha ṭ+wām̐ gi dbyibs can 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma/ bdud rtsi/ khrag gi mchod yon rnams gsol bas dgyes par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ lha chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas la// 'bras chen khrag gi ar+ghaṃ dang*// me tog bdug pa byug pa dang*// bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga dang*// khur ba shing tog sna tshogs dang*// bcas pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kun// bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags na// 'khor dang bcas pas bzhes su gsol/ hūm̐/ bla med mchod pa khyad par can// sha chen lnga ni ri ltar spungs// bdud rtsi lnga ni mtsho ltar bskyil// rak+ta gi waṃ ga pur dang*// a mṛ ta dang sha chen sogs// dam rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// mchod pa'i sprin phung mtha' yas pa// mkha' dang phyogs mtshams kun bkang ste// mgon po'i sku la mchod par 'bul// mgon po'i gsung la=

mgon po'i thugs la= thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol// byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi bzed zhal du sbreng zhing*/ bh+yo/ rin chen in+d+ra nī la'i bum par ni// 'bru bcud stong sbyar dza gad dpa' bos gtams// gnyis med byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin mchog /'thungs pas 'tsho ba'i longs spyod chen po 'di// 'bul ni ye shes dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bskang ni ma mgon lcam dral thugs dam bskang*// a la la ho 'di ni bzhes su gsol// a la la ho bzhes te dgyes par rol// oṃ ma hā kā la traka rak+ṣa dza gad kha raṃ khā hi/ bzed zhal gcig tu khrag gi mchod yon sbreng zhing*/ bh+yo/ rak+ta khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba la// snang srid thams cad rba rlabs 'khyil li li// mkha' dbyings rgyal ba ma lus mchod pa dang*// 'phags pa rnams mchod lcam dral thugs dam bskang*// a la la ho 'di ni= a la la ho bzhes te= oṃ ma hā kā la traka rak+ṣa rak+ta pi pa to khā hi/ bh+yo/ gzhong pa rnam dag zla gam dkyil 'khor du// tshe dang 'gal gyi thun gnyis thun sdebs te// dkar gyi thig btab dmar gyi gur phub pa// longs spyod rdzas kyi mchod pa chen po 'di// 'bul ni ye shes dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bskang ni ma= a la la ho 'di= a la la ho bzhes te dgyes par rol// oṃ sarba badz+ra ā tsār+ya sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ sarba bigh+nan sarba sha trūm̐ mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā lā ya/ de wa rak+ṣa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: 'dir shog 'dir shog /ā gats+tsha ya a gats+tsha ya/ hūm̐ ya dzaḥhūm̐ ya dzaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā lā ya/ shā sa naṃ/ u pa kā ri ṇāṃ/ eṣā pañtsi ma kā lo yaṃ/ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇāṃ/ ya ti pra tidz+nyā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de ni me ke na/

mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba liṃ pū dza khā hi/ oṃ e ā ral+li hoḥ shrī ma hā kā la khā hi/ traka rak+ṣa khā hi/ trag rak+ṣa thun bh+yo khā hi/ traka rak+ṣa rbad bh+yo khā hi/ dam can mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs su gyur pa rnams/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma bzhes su gsol/ khā hi/ oṃ ya ma rā dza/ ga ta k+ṣo bh+ya ya/ k+ṣo bha ya/ ba ta li pa ta le khā hi khā hi/ gṛ h+na ba liṃ/ gra ha gra ha/ oṃ maṃ tsaṃ ma hā bhai ra wā ya swā hā/ oṃ shrī k+ṣiṃ gṛh+ṇa ba liṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mad+ya maṃ sa puṣ+pa dhū pa rak+ta/ ta ta li pa ta li aṣ+ṭa nā ga de wa yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ i maṃ ba liṃ hā hā hā hūm̐ khā hūm̐ khā hi khā hi kha kha hūm̐ dzaḥ pheṃ pheṃ/ heṃ heṃ ma hā ḍa tā ra hā sa gardza gardza kṛṣ+ṇa war+ṇā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ trag rak+ṣa ma hi dun bh+yo/ ma hā yak+ṣa/ tīk+ṣ+ṇa kā li dun bh+yo/ i daṃ ba liṃ pū dza khā hi/ ma mo nag mo be ta li/ ku lu ku lu/ ha ha ha/ ma hā maṃ sa kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā tsit+ta/ ma hā ba su ta/ ma hā mañtsa me tsi/ ma hā go ro tsa na/ ma hā a mṛ ta/ ma hā su ra ta/ ma hā ba liṃ ta/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri kha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ sarba dz+nyā na dharma pā la/ lo ka dharma pā la/ kā la bi tā am+bo ṣo ḍa sha /da sha dig lo ka pā la nā tha da sha /dwā da sha sab+ta shrī nā tha/ tri ru dra a shwa ka /sab+ta mā tā/ tsa tu ra bhā gi nī/ nā ba dz+wa lā/ tsa tu ra kā la de wī/ tsa tu ra ṇī ka rā dzī/ aṣ+ṭa biṃ sha ti i sha rī/ dwā da sha tiṣ+ṭha/ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ pū dza khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa/ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ= oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wi kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ༈

dpal ye shes mgon po lcam dral rjes 'brang dang bcas pa la bskul ba'i myur mgyogs glog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ hūm̐ḥdzaḥ ye shes mgon po lcam dral 'khor tshogs rnams// rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par sgrub brgyud la// gzugs can mi dang gzugs med dam sri yis// gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bdud dpung dang*// gdug pa'i sems 'chang da dgra phod btsug rnams// ma rung gtum po chen po'i zhal du stobs// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis bka' bsgos bzhin// dam bca' ma g.yel bsrung skyobs phrin las mdzod// ces dang*/ ༈ bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas// dpal ldan mgon po nag po che// 'khor du nag po stong gis bskor// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan de// nyi ma gung la shar ba bzhin// dge 'dun dbu 'phang dgung la bstod// sdang ba'i dgra bo las ngan rnams// rjes shul tsam yang med par mdzod// drag po'i phrin las myur du sgrubs// hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral rnams// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*// mchog thun las rnams 'grub par mdzod// ces pa'ang 'og min mtshur phu'i gdan sar 7 rgyal ba'i dbang po bcu bdun pa o rgyan 'phrin las rdo rje'i gsung ngo*// blo gros bye ba'i stobs las rab 'bar zhing*// dkar phyogs bstan srung gang du phyogs bcur dag /thugs bskyed dam btsan yal med 'dor ram kye// sgrub brgyud 'di nyid srung zhing skyobs mdzod la// 'da' med bro bor tha tshig rjes dran mdzod// ces karma pa bcu drug pas shar mar bris pa'o// ༈ bstan srung 'khor lnga rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gtor 'bul phyogs gcig tu bkod pa bzhugs/ hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dngos 'gro mgon bla ma yi// phrin las sprul pa ma hā kā la'i zhabs// yum chen las mkhan sde brgyad bcas pa la// kun bzang mchod sprin spungs pa'i zhal zas dang*// sgo gsum longs spyod bcas pa phud kyis mchod// phyi yi mchod pa ngo mtshar snang ba dang*// nang gi mchod pa sha khrag a mṛ ta// gsang ba'i mchod pa bde stong tsakra dang*// de kho na'i thugs dam gcig bsdom pa'i// rang rig ye shes dag pa'i mchod gtor 'di// dgyes pa chen por bzhes la byin gyis rlobs// dbang bzhi rdzogs nas phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs// mkha' mnyam sems can bde la 'god nus pa'i// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub da lta stsol// stan thog 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol//

zhes pa 'di 'gro mgon ras chen pas sbyar ba'o// ༈ oṃ be ta li be ta li tshe tshe lha mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ bong bu gwa pa la chibs pa spyan drangs shing gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye/ de wi kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bh+yo/ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal// gtum mo gtsigs byed yi dwags kha// dam tshig srung ma khrag dga' ma// kī li'i sgra sgrogs sbyor zin ma// dur khrod ro yi tshogs dbus su// tshogs dang pho nya bcas pa ru// gtsigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma// gsol zhig bzhes shig dam tshig lha// gnas su gnas par mdzad du gsol// bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa// de ni khyod kyis bsgrub par mdzod// bdag gis las ni ci byed kyang*// de la khyod kyis grogs mdzod cig /lha mo nag mo mthu mo che// 'phags ma khyod la bdag bstod do// bstan la gnod pa'i gdug pa kun// myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod// nyin dang mtshan du bya ra mdzod// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces pa mar pa'i snyan brgyud shog dril lo// ༈ rnam sras gtor 'bul ni/ rang gi mdun du stegs kyi thog tu snod gang yang rung ba'i nang du/ dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs pa 'byor tshad blugs nas mdun du bzhag oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gnyis su med par bsgom/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye bas/ oṃ ā mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇā ya/ i daṃ ba ling gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ ma ma sarba karma sid+dhi a mo gha swā hā/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa nā ga sha dhu ta sā hā sra ko ṭi yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa swā hā/ i daṃ ba ling ghṛh+nan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ ma ma sarba karma sid+dhi a mo gha swā hā/ zhes pas klu brgyad dang*/

gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po bye ba'i tshogs la 'bul lo// phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras// gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes nas kyang*// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la// bu sdug bzhin du rtag tu skyong bar mdzod// bdag la gnod par sems pa yi// log par zhugs pa'i sems can rnams// de yi phru ma gzhom pa dang*// gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che mnga' ba'i// gnod sbyin bdag po khyed rnams kyis// bdag gi bsam pa ma lus pa// myur du grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes yig brgya brjod do// ༈ sngags bdag gtor 'bul ni/ mchod gtor rnams/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ bcud lha dang mi'i longs spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs kyis gang ba/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsgom/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi char bzhin du bab cing dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba bskyed par byed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ a kā ro lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// lha rdzas dge ba'i mchod gtor 'di// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol// dag gsal dri zhim legs ldan pa'i// dri chab bdug spos me tog sogs// klu rgyal khyod la 'bul lags na// bdag gi las rnams grub par mdzod// yid 'ong legs sbyar ro ldan pa'i// sbrang rtsi dang ni shing tog sogs// klu rgyal khyod la 'bul lags na// bdag cag 'khor bcas bkra shis mdzod// phun tshogs dbyibs legs yid 'ong dang*// yid 'dzin sgra snyan rol mo dang*// dri zhim yid 'ong phun sum tshogs// 'bras chan la sogs zhal zas dang*// 'jam mnyen mdzes pa'i na bza' sogs// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bdag gi bsam pa 'grub pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar mdzod// nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ

sogs klu rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi tshul du gtor ma la zugs nas gsol bas mnyes shing dgyes par bsams la/ oṃ phu ta phu ta ma hā kro dha hūm̐/ sid+dhi sid+dhi s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ swā hā/ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes bdun nam/ nyer gcig brjod/ bka' bsgo ba dang phrin las bcol ba ni/ sngags kyi bdag po 'jig rten mthu chen/ srid gsum tshar gcod/ 'gro drug dbang sdud/ khams gsum bdag po/ gsod byed chen po/ sbrul mgo bdun pa/ zur phud lnga pa/ khye'u chung gzhon nu/ gzhon nu mdzes pa/ gzhon nu gtum po/ nag po chen po/ bdud po chen po/ klu rgyal sog ma med/ las mkhan chen po/ bran po chen po/ g.yog po chen po/ khol po chen po/ khyod kyis mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ bdag gi bran po'i tshul gyis shig /bdag gi g.yog po'i tshul gyis shig /bdag gi las mkhan gyi tshul gyis shig /sngags kyi bdag po khyod kyis bdag gis bsgo ba bzhin gyis shig nā ga rā dza dga' ba dang dgyes par gyur cig/ ༈ dam can gtor 'bul ni/ gtor ma oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a las pad+ma'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga*/ bi mu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga/ yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /ba dan bskyod pas rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

lan gsum/ 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dam can skyes bu chen po 'khor bcas la// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma chen po dang*// ra yi rnam lnga tshil gyi dud pa 'di// dam can skyes bu khyod la mchod par 'bul// khams gsum stong gsum 'byung bzhi las grub pa'i// nor gyi mchog gyur rin chen rnam pa bdun// dam rdzas ba ling la sogs thams cad kyang*// dam can skyes bu khyod la mchod par 'bul// sangs rgyas bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs dang*// bla ma la sdang gsang sngags smod pa sogs// sgrub pa po la sdang ba'i dgra bo yi// dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag mchod par 'bul// khyod la mchod pa phul ba'i bsod nams kyis// khams gsum sems can bde zhing skyid pa dang*// sgrub pa po la tshe ring nad med cing*// mthu dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya wa ka traṃ traṃ shi ni kra ma ni sa ma ya sā dhu tri dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ i daṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun sogs brjod/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'bul lo// yongs su bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig / ces 'dod don gsol lo// ༈ srin mgon gtor 'bul ni/ a kā ro sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ gcig yab la/ gcig yum la/ gcig 'khor la 'bul te/ oṃ/ dpal chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// legs par brgyan cing bshams pa'i mchod gtor rnams// mthun rdzas 'dod pa'i longs spyod bsam mi khyab// dbang po lnga yi tshim byed bdud rtsi'i gter// rgya chen zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod// zag med bde ba bskyed pa'i mchod sprin du// ting 'dzin phyag rgya sngags kyi byin brlabs nas// rnal 'byor gus pa'i yid kyis 'bul lags na// thod phreng yab yum 'khor bcas spyan lam du// ci 'dod mkho dgu'i longs spyod sna tshogs pa// chos nyid rnam dag lhag bsam bden pa'i mthus// rgyun du thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig

/bha ga wa ti tiṣ+ṭha rak+ṣa rak+mo sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ i daṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig gis 'bul lo// ༈ zhing skyong gtor 'bul ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gdug pa can mtha' dag bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha'i ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i phung po/ gzhan yang bza' btung gi bye brag sna tshogs pa gtsang zhing gsod pa dang yid du 'ong bas yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ma hā kā la sing ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa tri hring dza: ḍā ki ni si na ra ma hūm̐ phaṭa tri hring dzaḥ ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig sogs kyis phul bas 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i rkan sgra dang bcas te gsol bas tshim par bltas la/ dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong pa can/ yum chen si na ra ma/ myur mgyogs las byed pho mo/ stobs ldan pho nya sde brgyad/ srog 'phrog bdud dmag stong sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di tshim zhing dgyes par bzhes la/ bstan pa rin po che phyogs bcur 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa 'tsho zhing bzhes pa rnams yun ring du zhabs pad brtan pa dang*/ bdag cag slob 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pa chos sgrub pa'i phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen mi dang mi ma yin gyis 'tshe ba las bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba ba dang*/ nad dang gdon rnams las thar bar mdzad du gsol/ rbod gtong ngan pa thams cad phyir bzlog pa dang*/ gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo thams cad dbang du sdud pa dang*/ tshar gcod pa'i phrin las thogs pa med pa yid bzhin du bsgrub tu gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/

bh+yo/ bdud kyi dmag dpon yab yum 'khor bcas la// bstan la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi// dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho'i yon chab dang*// sha khrag tshil bu rkang dang nang khrol dang*// don snying lnga dang dbang po rnam pa lnga// sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang*// tshil chen dud pa zhun chen mar me dang*// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a mṛ ta// zhal zas 'dod yon tshogs kyi longs spyod dang*// dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru sman rtsi bcud dang*// chang dang shing tog dar tshon sna tshogs dang*// thod pa'i rnga chung rkang gling rol mo'i sgra// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul byas nas// 'bul gyi dam tshig dbang gis bzhes su gsol// dam rdzas brgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// bdag gi las rnams thams cad bsgrub tu gsol// rbod gtong phur kha bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo da sgrol cig / ces phrin las bcol lo// ༈ mkhar nag gtor 'bul ni/ gtsang sbra dang ldan pas dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs ji ltar 'byor ba'i klu sman rin po che btab pa bshams te/ oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*// a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ yig las// rin chen snod du gnas pa'i gtor ma ni// dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ a mṛ te āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ nā ga rā dza badz+ra rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ i daṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐/ klu btsan rnams kyi ded dpon che// klu rje thod dkar chen po'i sras// klu mtsho mer pa'i nang shed na// klu rgyal chen po khyod la bstod// sku mdog nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs// phyag na nor bu rin chen bsnams// stobs ldan glang chen steng na gnas// 'jigs byed chen po khyod la bstod// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// mthu dang byin rlabs nus pa dang*// bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa yis// mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen po// 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di// dngos 'byor yid kyis phul ba yis// dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas rnams// rab tu tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig

ces gtor ma gtsang sar skyel la 'dod don gsol bar bya'o// ༈ a phyi'i gtor 'bul ni/ hrīḥ kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar bzhin// nam mkha' gang ba'i mchod gtor 'di// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags na// yum gcig khyod nyid dgyes par rol// chos dang ye shes dam tshig lha// dbang gi lha mo sprul pa'i sku// sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro ste// phrin las sna tshogs de la 'dud// tshe ring mi g.yo blo bzang ma// mthing gi zhal bzang ma la sogs// las kyi bdag nyid ḍā ki'i 'khor// du mar bcas la bdag bstod do// bdag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bka' rgyud yongs kyi bstan pa srungs// rdo rje slob dpon sku tshe srings// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// chos rje khu dbon bka' nyan zhing*// skyu ra'i gdung dang mi 'bral bar// bstan pa srung bar khas blangs bzhin// 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs bzhin mdzod/ /oṃ ghā mu a dzi te dharmā dī pi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ༈ tshe ring ma'i gtor 'bul ni/ bh+yo/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na// bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams na// gangs dkar shel gyi cod paṇa can// phu chu snyan pa'i rgyun sgra can// nags ma me tog sham bu can// g.ya' spang g.yu yi ska rags can// sman ljongs brag gi ra ba can// gnas mchog de 'dra'i g.yon mgul na// dar dkar gur gyi nang shed na// rin chen sna lnga'i khri steng na// bkra shis tshe yi dbang phyug ma// drag po'i gdung bas khyod 'bod na// de ring sgrub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// lhab lhub na bza'i rgyan dang bcas// sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// nam mkha'i mthongs nas spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol// añdzi dha ri'i rigs kyi ḍā ki nī// kun gyi gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// de yi mched zla za byed chen mo bzhi// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi añdzi dha ri pañtsa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ hūm̐/ lha sman bkra shis tshe ring ma// khyod kyi cho dang 'brang smos pa// yab ni lho lha de bo yin// yum ni 'brang yul sman gcig ma// ming po bdun la sring mo lnga// lnga tshigs dbus kyi gtso mo ste// khyod ni gtsang rigs lha yi sras// mtshar sdug 'od du kyi li li// zhal bzang zla ba nya ba 'dra// lha mo rnams kyang zil gyis gnon// mgrin pa gcig la glu sgra stong*// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyang zil gyis gnon// dbu skra nyag ma re re la// gser g.yu'i lan tshar stong stong ldan// na bza' dar dkar go zu gsol// rin chen du mas sku lus brgyan// nyin gsum gangs dkar stod la bzhugs// sman mo rnams dang lhan cig rol// mtshan gsum rgya gar yul du bzhugs// rab tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod du// mkha' 'gro rnams dang tshogs 'khor rol// bka' nyan sprul pa'i pho nya sogs// ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// 'dir byon bdag gi phrin las mdzod/ hūm̐/ khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bdud rtsi sman gyi rtsi phud dang*// me tog yid 'ong mdzes pa'i tshal// spos dri phun sum tshogs pa dang*// sgron me dri mchog bshos gtsang dang*// sgra snyan gsang ba'i rnge'u chung rnams// thugs brtser dgongs shing bzhes nas kyang*// byin rlabs dngos grub stsal du gsol// sngon tshe dben gnas yongs rdzong du// dpal ldan bzhad pa rdo rje la// rang rtags srog gi snying po phul// bka' 'bangs bgyid par rtsis la phab// chos brgyud spel bar g.yar dam bcas// de ring sman btsun rgyal mo la// ming pos gsol ba 'debs pa ni// srid srung rigs rgyud spel ba dang*// snang gsal pra yi dngos grub dang*// rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub dang*// bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub dang*// rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub dang*// gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yi// dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol// khyod la gsol ba 'debs pa ni// rnal 'byor tshe srings gzi mdangs skyed// nang gi rlung sems dbang du sdus// zag bcas lus kyi bde ba skyed// phyi yi snang ba dbang du sdus// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// bkra shis dpal skyed 'khor skyongs la// 'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen sgrubs// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa sogs// bcol ba'i las kyi 'bras bu de// mchis par mdzod cig thugs dam can// oṃ añdzi dha ri pañtsa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/

gser skyems phud kyis mchod par 'dod na/ 'bru sman rin po che zas sna tshogs chang phud bzang po dang sbyar bas mchod cing 'di skad do// hūm̐/ rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum// sku mdog dkar mo gzhon tshul can// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje bsnams// g.yon pas tshe yi bum pa 'dzin// bum pa'i steng na dpal be'u dang*// g.yung drung rin chen 'khyil bas brgyan// lhab lhub na bza'i rgyan dang ldan// sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// rin chen du mas mdzes par brgyan// bkra shis tshe yi gtso mo ste// chibs su seng ge dkar mo chibs// gangs dkar stod na bzhugs pa mo// mchod gtor 'di bzhes dngos grub stsol// srid srung rigs brgyud 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// mchod do gtsang ma'i phud kyis mchod// lha mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// rdo rje khros ma zhes su grags// sku mdog sngo sangs 'tsher bag can// chibs su rkyang bu kha dkar chibs// phyag g.yas dngul dkar me long bsnams// g.yon pas lha yi ba dan phyar// sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol// sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// mchod gtor= snang gsal bden mthong pra yi dngos grub stsol// mchod do= lha mo mi g.yo blo bzang ma// gsang mtshan rdo rje bzhad pa mo// sku mdog ser mo gser gyi mdog /chibs su cha stag khra bo chibs// phyag g.yas rin chen sder bzang nang*// lha yi zhal zas sna tshogs bsnams// g.yon na ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin// sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod cig /mchod gtor= rma g.yang ro mchog zas kyi dngos grub stsol// mchod do= lha mo cod paṇa mgrin bzang ma// rdo rje dpal mo longs spyod yum// sku mdog dmar gsal mdangs dang ldan// chibs su sha ba yu mo chibs// phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dang*// phyag g.yon rin chen sgrom bu bsnams// snang srid thams cad dbang sdus la// rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las sgrubs// mchod gtor=

bang mdzod 'bru nor 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// mchod do= lha mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma// gsang mtshan rdo rje gar mkhan ma// sku mdog sngo ljang mdangs dang ldan// chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon mo chibs// phyag g.yas rtswa mchog dūrba dang*// g.yon pas sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams// phrin las thogs pa med pa yi// mthu dang nus pa 'dir ston cig /mchod gtor= rkang bzhi rta phyugs 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// mchod do gtsang ma'i phud kyis mchod/ /gsol lo mchod do// jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ mkha' 'gro lnga 'khor rgya mtsho dang bcas pa/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can dang*/ ta mā la ri khrod ma dang*/ gtum mo dang*/ sngo sangs ma dang*/ bī na mo badz+ra dang*/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ dpal bzhad pa rdo rje la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ bstan 'dzin gyi bu slob skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ log 'dren gdug pa can rnams kyi bsam pa ngan pa dang*/ sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad thal ba'i rdul bzhin du brlag pa dang*/ bdag cag gi bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub cing chos ldan gyi bya ba mthar phyin pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu thob pa'i phrin las mdzod cig/ ༈ brag btsan gyi gsol mchod bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bh+yo/ bdag nyid dpal chen spyan snga ru// sngon gyi dam tshig dbang gis ni// btsan rgod ri bkra'i gnas mchog nas// rdo rje dbang drag 'bar ba rtsal// sprul 'khor bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs// phyi nang mchod tshogs bsang gsur dud// bshug glu rnga rol la sogs dang*// khyad par sdang dgra'i sha khrag rus// rkang klad ngo bo'i gtor ma 'di// 'bul lo dgyes bzhes rol cig rol// bdag cag dam ldan sgrub pa po'i// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las kun// thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzod// skya rgyal 'brong bu gnyen po sogs// 'go ba'i lha srung rnams la yang*// mchod tshogs rgya mtshos legs mchod do// bstod do brngan no mnga' gsol lo// kaṃ tshang bstan dang bstan 'dzin spel// mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyor// bkra shis bde legs rgyas par mdzod// ya ma rā dza tsa mun+ti khrag rgal mun tse sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ

i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rak+ta pi pa to sarba shā trūm̐ mā ra ya tsit+ta khā hi/ ༈ dam can 'bar ba rtsal gyi rgyun khyer bzhugs/ oṃ ā ka ro sa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ/ dri za'i rgyal po sa brgyad gnas pa'i mchog /stong gsum gzhi bdag kun gyi rje bor gyur// 'khor tshogs dang bcas brgya byin sras mo ni// mtsho sman bcas pa 'dir gshegs gtor ma bzhes// bdag gi bsam pa thams cad bsgrub pa dang*// bstan pa 'phel zhing 'dod dgu rgya cher ldan// gdug 'dre'i nad dang gnod pa zhi ba dang*// thams cad bde dgar spyod pa'i bkra shis stsol// oṃ āḥm ṇu ṣe gan+dhar+bha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha li a mṛ ta khā hi khā hi/ badz+ra 'bar ba rtsal ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe a lo ke ghan+dhe nai wi d+yaṃ shab+da pra tits+tsha āḥhūm̐/ zhes gtor ma bsngo'o// hūm̐/ yang cig bzhengs shing nag po ti pa rā tsa khyod// byang phyogs rgyud du che ba'i skur ston pa// gnyan chen thang lha zhes su mtshan yang gsol// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rig 'dzin rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun rkyen sol mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrubs// sprul pa dung g.yag dung gi bya khra dang*// lcags sdig mgo dgu'i tshul du 'dir byon la// gnod byed rgyal 'gong smyo 'dre rdul du rlog /dam bcas dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ badz+ra 'bar ba rtsal bighān rā dza mā ra ya phaṭa/ zhes pa rnams kyis 'bul bar bya'o// ༈ de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/

go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga/ so sor yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gis me sbar/ mes thod pa dros pas rdzas rnams zhu/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro/ gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ zhing las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tshan+dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad la sogs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/ nub phyogs o rgyan/ byang sham bha la/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bo/ shrī nā lan+d+ra/ bi kra ma la shrī la'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i grub chen rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas rnams su gnas pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lho gro bo lung*/ 'brog la phyi chu bar/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga/ shar dwags lha dpal gyi sgam po/ stod lung mtshur phu/

kaṃ po gnas nang*/ karma ri gling*/ shar phyogs spungs ri/ lho gnas mchog dpal gyi tsā ri tra/ gangs dkar gyi rgyal po ti se/ mtsho ma pham/ bal yul 'phags pa shing kun/ shing ki ri'i mchod rten/ rong btsan kha ba dkar po/ chos 'khor lha sa/ dpal gyi bsam yas la sogs pa gangs ri'i khrod kyi sgrub gnas byin rlabs can rnams su gnas pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku gsung thugs shin tu mnyes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams kyi mthun rkyen sgrub/ 'gal rkyen sol/ 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'babs pa dang*/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad dang*/ yams nad dang*/ 'khrug rtsod thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ gzhi bdag dkar gtor ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang / stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum kha dog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ stong gcig pa/ stong gnyis pa/ stong gsum pa/ mtho ba nam mkha'/ dma' ba sa gzhi/ ri rab chen po'i sa bdag /gser gyi ri bdun/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ gling bzhi gling phran la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag /dzam bu gling gi zo dor/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ bod kyi mgul lha bcu gsum/ srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug /sgang lngar gnas pa'i gzhi'i bdag po/ gnas kyi bdag po/ yul gyi bdag po/ grong gi bdag po/ gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang sa bdag sa'i lha mo brtan ma/ sa 'dzin lag pa chen po/ spar kha brgyad/

sme ba dgu/ lo skor bcu gnyis/ sa bdag gi rgyal po the se la sogs pa de ring gi nyi ma/ gza'/ rgyu skar/ dus tshod/ tshes grangs la dbang ba'i gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag sngon chad gang du song zhing*/ phyin chad gang du 'gro ba/ da lta gang du gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pha ri g.yas/ tshu ri g.yon/ 'gro ba lam/ skye ba shing*/ 'bab pa chu/ sra ba brag /g.yo ba rlung*/ brten pa mkhar la sogs pa sa phyogs/ yul phyogs/ dben gnas/ sgrub gnas 'di nyid du gnas pa'i gzhi bdag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' zhing byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku gsung thugs mnyes nas rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa 'gro na ma bzung*/ sdod na ma bskrad/ bsam pa ma ngan/ sbyor ba ma rtsub/ 'tsho ba sbyor/ yon bdag gyis/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ 'gal rkyen sol/ rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod//

de nas bstod pa bya ba ni rang gi lus grangs med sprul nas phyag 'tshal bar mos la dkon mchog gsum dang khyad par chos skyong gi yon tan dran bzhin pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dang por me tog phog pa'i lha// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lor sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// lte ba'i dbus nas 'byung bzhi 'phro// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par ldan// mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdud mdzad ma// rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud sde bzhi// ston pa nyid kyis gang gsungs pa'i// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi// yi dam rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa// gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do// mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che// gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas// g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang gsol// thod phreng can la bdag bstod do// khros pa'i zhabs brdab sa gzhi g.yo// 'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel// dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa// dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ bh+yo/ rlung nag 'tshub ma dgu klong 'khyil ba'i dbus// pho brang gzhal yas thod pa'i sku mkhar nas// ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo chen mo ni// srin po nag po'i chung ma ral pa can// gsang ba'i lha mo bong zhon dbang phyug ma// zhal ni zla ltar bzhad pas mun pa sel// rngams pa'i tshul gyis thod khrag dmar la rol// skye ba rnam bzhi'i 'gro ba'i don ston ma// khyod ni nag mo 'bum gyi dbus na bzhugs// dbang phyug drag mo kun gyi gtso mo ste// khro mo kun gyi thugs kyi sprul pa yin// nye bar dam tshig las rnams grub par mdzod// rdo rje nag mo mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dang sbyor ba'i yum// srid gsum za bar byed pa'i lha mo la// shing lo rlung khyer sa la ma phog nga la yod// mi dbang 'bras bu smin pa'i sha ni skam legs dang*// mtshal gyi shing tog skam po bu la yod// rnam dag bdud rtsi gtor mas mnyes mchod 'bul// ma bus bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// nag po yab yum bcu drug dang*// dpal 'bar 'chang dang rnam sras sogs// dbang phyug che sogs ma bdun sogs// dregs byed kun la bdag bstod do// bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// sgrub par mdzad pa'i gang zag la// bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi/

/ gsol kha 'bul ba ni/ mchod gtor ba liṃ bzang du bshams par bdud rtsi 'thor zhing*/ daṃ ṣ+ṭot+ka ṭa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las byung ba'i mgo bo'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu zhing*/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa'i gtor ma rnams dang*/ hūm̐ yig nag po dpag tu med pa las byung ba'i sgrub pa'i rdzas/ mchod pa'i rdzas/ bskang ba'i rdzas/ bsten pa'i rdzas la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā maṃ sa āḥhūm̐/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ ba su ta/ mañtsa me tsi/ go ro tsa na/ a mṛ ta/ su ra ta/ ba liṃ ta/ kiṃ ni ri ti/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐/ bstan srung mthar thug rdo rje ber can dang*// yum chen dpal ldan lha mo rang byung ma// nag po yab yum phyogs bcu'i mgon po dang*// dregs pa don gnyis bdud btsan klu yi mgon// rnam sras sngags bdag skyes bu rdo rje legs// srin mgon zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu dang*// ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma dgu rnams dang*// dus bzhi lha mo dmag gi rgyal mo bzhi// dbang phyug nyer brgyad brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*// mkhar nag rdor rgyal bkra shis tshe ring sogs// lha klu gzhi bdag mthu bo che rnams dang*// pho nya las mkhan bsam yas grangs 'das la// mnyes rdzas drag po'i gta' gtor chen po dang*// sman dang rak+ta gser dngul dar zab sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod rdzas 'bul// dgyes par bzhes la ci bsam phrin las sgrubs// zhes gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi gsol bsdus dbang phyug rdo rjes mdzad pa la/ rgyal dbang bcu bzhi pas 'khor lnga rjes 'brang bcas kha 'gengs mdzad pa dang*/

hūm̐/ bde chen chos dbyings klong yangs nas// thugs rje'i thabs mkhas sprul pa'i sku// gtum chen khro bo'i skur bzhengs nas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung mdzad pa// dpal chen ma hā kā la che// ye shes mgon po gnas 'dir byon// dpal ldan mgon po gnas 'dir byon// sras mchog nag po gnas 'dir byon// las kyi mgon po gnas 'dir byon// 'jig rten mgon po gnas 'dir byon// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi// sprul pa'i mgon po sde lnga sogs// phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi /sprul pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kun// 'dir gshegs dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin bzhes// gang bcol phrin las sgrub par mdzod// ces rol mo 'bul/ hūm̐/ nag po 'gugs byed chen po dang*// nag po snying khrag 'thung byed dang*// nag po dbugs len chen po dang*// nag po srog gi bdag po dang*// nag po dur khrod 'joms byed dang*// nag po kha lo sgyur byed dang*// nag po gdug pa 'dul byed dang*// nag po sreg byed chen po sogs// dbugs len bcu drug gnas 'dir byon// dpal rab 'chang dang dpal 'bar nag /dbang phyug 'bar ba rnam thos sras// dzam bha la dang mdzes ldan sras// sha ba ri dang gtsug tor ljang*// gtsug phud can dang brtan ma sogs// phyogs bcu'i mgon po gnas 'dir byon// dbang phyug ljang dang srin po che// dur khrod nag po gshin rje dang*// klu rgyal dga' bo khyab mjug dmar// bi nā ya ka traka shad sogs// dregs pa don gnyis gnas 'dir byon// bdud btsan klu yi mgon po ste// dregs pa rkya gsum gnas 'dir byon// gzhan yang sprul pa'i pho nya ni// bye ba dung phyur du ma'i tshogs// bya nag khyi nag gcan gzan dang*// mkha' lding la sogs sprul pa dang*// yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs thams cad// 'dir byon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin bzhes// gang bcol phrin las sgrub par mdzod//

ces rol mo 'bul/ hūm̐/ ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi// chos skyong srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs// 'dir byon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// bdag dang sprul pas phyag 'tshal zhing*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod// 'dod yon rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul// ba liṃ gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul// dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul// bdud rtsi dza gad mchod pa= zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa= dgra bo'i sha khrag mchod pa 'bul// rab tu 'gyod pas nyes kun bshags// thugs dang 'gal ba bzod par gsol// khyod la bcol ba'i phrin las ni// rdo rje slob dpon mtshan ldan dang*// rdo rje mched lcam dam tshig ldan// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang*// de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang*// 'khor dang longs spyod dbang sdud dang*// bdud dpung 'joms shing dgra bgegs 'dul// nad pa sri'u gso ba dang*// gtsug lag khang srung chos 'khor skyong*// pha rol dmag dpung bzlog pa dang*// byad ma rbod gtong bzlog pa dang*// nad rim dal kha bsgyur ba dang*// ban dgra log lta rang gshed 'bebs// byol po chags chen bzlog la sogs// gang gsol phrin las khyod kyis mdzod// sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis srungs// dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyod kyis bstod// bla ma'i sku dgra khyod kyis thul// rnal 'byor sgos dgra khyod kyis sgrol// rjes 'jug bu slob khyod kyis skyongs// dkor dang rten mchod khyod kyis srungs// pho nya don sgrub bsu skyel gyis// dad mos yon bdag khyod kyis skyong*// mi nor rta phyugs khyod kyis srungs// sgrub pa'i bar chad khyod kyis sol// gsang sngags bzlas rgyun khyod kyis zungs// mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyor// thugs dam zhal bzhes ma g.yel cig /zas su dgra bo'i sha la zo// skom du dgra bo'i khrag la 'thung*// las su gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol// khyad par dpal ldan karma pa'i// bstan la gnod byed thams cad kun// ming tsam med par rdul du rlog

/bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs pad brtan// mdzad phrin nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// karma kaṃ tshang bstan pa mchog /dzam gling kun tu khyab par rgyas// ci bsam lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// ces rgyal mchog bcu bzhi pas mdzad pa'i mgon po pho rgyud dang*/ snang srid zil gnon grub chen pak+shi sogs// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// 'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// ma hā kā la rdo rje ber nag can// dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma// kun dga' gzhon nu dam can rdo rje legs// rnam mang thos sras jo bo sngags kyi bdag /srin mgon mkhar nag a phyi tshe ring mched// rdo rje brag btsan thang lha spom ra sogs// bstan bsrung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa// rang bzhin gnas nas 'dir byon dgyes par bzhugs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin 'dod yon dang*// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung longs spyod kyi// bye brag rnam mang rgya cher bkod pa'i rigs// 'bul bzhes brtse bas dgongs la byin gyis rlobs// dngos grub gnyis stsol phyi nang gsang ba yi// bar chad kun sol mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrub// byang chub lam gyi mi mthun kun zhi nas// bla med go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa 'di rdo stod bla ma nges don nas bskul phyir/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba dge/ ༈ da ni rnal 'byor pa chags che zhing phyi nang gi rkyen du ma lhongs na nyams chags bskang ba'i phyir/ bskang ba rgyun par 'dod na/ gtor ma phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ nyer spyod spyan gzigs sna tshogs dang bcas pa bshams nas/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ a las ka pā la'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga ste/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis sbyangs rtogs sbar 'od gsal bar byas te/ dri ro phun sum tshogs pa'i gzi brjid mtha' yas par gyur/

oṃ ā kā ro zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ 'di skad du/ skad cig gis bdag sogs nyon mongs pa dang*/ ma gus pa dang*/ bag ma mchis pa dang*/ ma shes pa rnams kyis rgyud ma rungs pa gdul dka' ba rnams kyis sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa gang mchis pa bshags nas sgrib par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan thugs rje can dpal nag po chen po lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod nas/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis bsags pa kun// bla med byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi// zhes dang*/ de nas/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar brjod nas/ 'dod pa'i gzugs sgra rnam dag rdo rje'i yul// khams kyi dri ro rnam dag zhi ba'i dbyings// sa yi reg bya chos khams rnam dag pa'i// bdud rtsi 'od zer 'bar ba'i mchod pa bzhes// bdag rgyud nyes pa gang mchis mthol lo bshags// phyin chad mi bgyid sdom pa slar yang len// sngon chad nongs pa'i las la 'gyod par mchis// 'di phyir sgrib par mi 'gyur dngos grub stsol// bskang ngo bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// thugs dam bskang las nyams chags sor chud mdzod// thugs rje chen pos bdag la dgongs par mdzod// nag po chen po yum gcig ral gcig ma// legs ldan nag po yum gcig rtsa 'jib dmar// sprul pa las mgon chen po bya rog gdong*// seng ge'i gdong can rnal 'byor ma khros pa// bya rgod mkha' lding khwa dang 'ug pa dang*// phag khyi lce spyang stag gi gdong pa can// sha za khrag 'thung ma mo 'khor bcas dang*// bya nag khyi nag sprul pa'i tshogs bcas kyis// thugs rje chen pos dgongs shig bcom ldan gyi// bka' dang 'gal ba thams cad mthol lo bshags// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig chags nyams skongs// thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis// chags che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol// phyi nang bar chad bzlog tu gsol// phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol//

zhes so// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bhan+dha rin chen 'bar ba'i snod yangs par// mthun rdzas sman raka gtor ma'i bye brag dang*// bsten dang sgrub dang mchod pa'i nyer spyod kun// mkha' dbyings gang ba dgyes bskyed rang bzhin gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ pū dza badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ bh+yoḥ chos dbyings bde chen yangs pa'i klong*// ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi// sprul pa'i rang byung dpal lha mo// srid pa'i rgyal mo gnas 'dir byon// mkha' dbyings bde klong 'khyil ba yi// rtag pa'i rgyal mo mu kha le// snang srid kun tu 'phrul byed pa'i// ma mo chen mo gnas 'dir byon// re ma dzu dang re ma dzaḥ re ma ti yang gnas 'dir byon// lha mo dung skyong gnas= re ti yum gcig gnas= rin chen sked bcings gnas = klog ltar 'gyu ma gnas= gshin rje'i lcam mo gnas= klu mo chen mo gnas= 'dod khams dbang phyug gnas= rang byung kun khyab gnas= grub pa'i dgra lha gnas= ma mo 'khor bcas gnas 'dir byon// dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang*// mnyes pa'i mchod tshogs bzhes su gsol/ bh+yo/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang mo che// rang byung rgyal mo gnas 'dir byon// rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs rnams kyi// dpal ldan lha mo gnas= klu mo chu srin gdong can dang*// khri sman mdog ldem gnas= 'gugs byed gsod byed sgrol byed dang*// srung byed ma bdun gnas= dkar sngo dmar ser 'dren byed ma// gsang ba sring bzhi gnas= gsal 'dzin 'bar ma klong dgu ma// yum chen 'bar ma gnas= srid pa dus bzhi la 'char ba'i// lha mo chen mo gnas= phyogs rnams kun tu 'dren pa yi// dmag gi rgyal mo gnas= ma sring chung ma bran mo yi// dbang phyug ma rnams gnas= bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo yi// brtan ma'i tshogs rnams gnas= srid gsum kun la gnas pa yi// ma mo'i tshogs rnams gnas 'dir byon// dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang*// mnyes pa'i mchod tshogs bzhes su gsol/

bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*// dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// rab tu dwangs bas phyag bgyi'o// mnyes byed bsten pa'i dam rdzas mchog /g.yab dar gsur dud 'bod pa'i rdzas// lug drel bya nag mda' dar dang*// gsang ba'i sku 'bag bhan+dha dang*// rkang 'thung 'dab ma rlung bskyod dang*// mi dbang sha dang mtshal gyi 'bras// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas dang*// rma bya seng ge'i rgyal mtshan dang*// g.yang gzhi re lde sha khrag sogs// sman sna chang phud a mṛ ta// ba liṃ rgyan pa'i gtor ma sogs// mchod pa'i rdzas gyur thams cad dang*// bdud rtsi dam tshig bsre ba'i rdzas// bdug spos dri ldan bskul ba'i rdzas// na chung dri med gsung dbyangs sogs// brten pa'i rdzas dang mchod pa yi// bye brag ma tshang med pa 'di// mkha' dbyings kun tu gang sprul te// dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas mchod// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams kun tu bshags// 'khrul zhing 'gal ba ma lus bskang*// tshangs shing bzod par mdzad du gsol// dam tshig mi 'da' rjes dgongs mdzod// phrin las dam pa bcol ba ni// rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnyan po srungs// bstan 'dzin sku tshe phrin las spel// bar chad g.yul ngo thal bar rlog /gtsug lag dge 'dun chos 'khor skyongs// sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan// 'khor slob rgyu sbyor la sogs pa'i// nad gdon nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang*// dpal 'byor rgyas shing mthun rkyen sdud// dgra bgegs dam sri sgrol ba sogs// 'dod pa'i phrin las gang yin pa// ma lus yid bzhin bsgrub tu gsol// ma mo 'khor bcas bskang ba'i mthus// phyi nang 'gal rkyen bzlog pa dang*// 'dod rgu char bzhin 'bebs pa yi// bkra shis dzam gling khyab par shog /

zhes zhwa dmar brgyad pas bstsal ba'i lha mo mo rgyud dang*/ hūm̐/ dam can khyod kyi thugs dang ci 'gal ba// ma rig dbang gis nyes pa byung ba rnams// rab tu 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// skyes bu khyod la phrag dog ma mchis kyang*// khyod kyi 'khor du gtogs pa'i 'jig rten pa// gdug pa'i tshogs ni de dag thams cad la// thugs dam 'gal bar gyur ba ci mchis pa// rab tu 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// bdag gis rab tu bshags pa'i bsod nams kyis// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun phyogs rnams ma lus zhi ba dang*// bsam pa 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ hūm̐/ dpal chen 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// khyod ni ye shes chen po'i spyan dang ldan// bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur lus ngag sems// nongs pa'i tshogs ni ci mchis bzod par gsol// rgyu chung phud nyams lhag ma 'dres pa dang*// dam rdzas ma tshang bsnyen bsgrub g.yel ba sogs// yab yum 'khor bcas thugs dang 'gal ba rnams// mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// bskang rdzas mchod gtor rnams la bdud rtsi bran te/ daṃ ṣ+ṭot+ka ṭa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las byung ba'i mgo bo'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu zhing*/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa'i gtor ma rnams dang*/ hūm̐ yig nag po dpag tu med pa las byung ba'i sgrub pa'i rdzas/ mchod pa'i rdzas/ bskang ba'i rdzas/ bsten pa'i rdzas la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā maṃ sa āḥhūm̐/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ ba su ta/ mañtsa me tsi/ go ro tsa na/ a mṛ ta/ su ra ta/

ba liṃ ta/ kiṃ ni ri ti/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*// yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// dpa' mo rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// ye shes mgon po'i= las kyi mgon po'i= 'jig rten mgon po'i= sras mchog nag po'i= dpal ldan lha mo'i= dbugs len yab yum= phyogs bcu mgon po'i= dregs pa don gnyis= dregs pa rnam gsum= ma mo bdun gyi= sring mo bzhi yi= 'bar ma dgu yi= dus bzhi lha mo'i= dmag gi rgyal mo'i= dbang phyug nyer brgyad= brtan ma bcu gnyis= sprul dang yang sprul= dam can rgya mtsho'i= thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis// chags che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol// phyi nang bar chad bzlog tu gsol// phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// dkyil 'khor gnyen po dral la re// nyes byed sdebs su shor la re// bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// rdo rje slob dpon slob mar bcas// rdo rje mched dang lcam dral dang*// rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la// mi la nad yams ma btang zhig /phyugs la god yams ma btang zhig /nor la gya gram ma btang zhig /zhing la rtsa sad ma btang zhig /bdud kyi zhags pa nag po chod// gshin rje'i khram kha dgra la sgyur// mi mthun bar chad rkyen rnams zlog /'khor rnams srung la rkyen rnams zlog /sdang ba'i dgra la rtags phyung zhig /gnod pa'i bgegs la las mdzod cig /'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang*// bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis// khro bo'i drag shul bzlog tu gsol// he ru ka yi gzi brjid zlog /phur pa'i byad ka bzlog tu gsol// stobs po che yi zil gnon zlog /lha rnams kun gyi rtsub rims zlog /lha min rnams kyi dug gzer zlog /gza' chen brgyad kyi gzer 'debs zlog /gshin rje'i pho mo'i 'khrul 'khor zlog

/bdud dmag rnams kyi khram kha zlog /ma mo rnams kyi thun zor zlog /klu chen rnams kyi 'ching ba zlog /gnod sbyin rnams kyi gzer nad zlog /btsan gyi rgyu srang bzlog tu gsol// rgyal po'i dbyings smyo thams cad zlog /mkha' 'gro'i khrag nad bzlog tu gsol// 'byung po yi dwags rims nad zlog /the'u rang 'gong po la sogs pa// dam sri log 'dren bgegs tshogs kyi// phugs kyi sris rkun thams cad zlog /bal mo'i dug mtshon bzlog tu gsol// sngon gyi sgrub brgyud gser ri'i phreng tshogs kyis// ji ltar bka' bsgos tha tshig ma g.yel bar// ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// dwags brgyud bstan dgra'i cho 'phrul zhi bar mdzod// oṃ ma hā kā la kā li ma hā maṃ sa kha raṃ khā hi/ de bzhin du/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ ba su ta/ mañtsa me tsi/ go ro tsa na/ a mṛ ta/ su ra ta/ ba liṃ ta/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes pas thugs dam bskang zhing phrin las bcol la/ man ngag gi yig brgya gzungs dang bcas pas nyams chags bshags/ slar yang mchod gtor kha gsos par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bhan+dha rin chen 'bar ba'i snod yangs par// mthun rdzas sman raka gtor ma'i bye brag dang*// bsten dang sgrub dang mchod pa'i nyer spyod kun// mkha' dbyings gang ba dgyes bskyed rang bzhin gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ pū dza badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ chags med zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i lha mo'i bskang ba ni/ bh+yo/ byang shar chos dbyings pho brang dam pa 'dir// rgyal ba'i bskyed yum lha mo dud sol ma// yams nad zhi mdzad bkra shis sha wa ri// bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// dbang phyug sras mo dkar mo dung skyong ma// mgon po'i lcam gcig dpal ldan rang byung ma// srid pa'i rgyal mo srid pa gsum gyi bdag

/sa brgyad sems ma chen mo'i thugs dam bskang*// gsang sngags srung ma sngags srung ral gcig ma// dpag bsam shing gi bdag mo 'od zer can// o rgyan gnas kyi gtso mo phag zhal can// dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso mo'i thugs dam bskang*// mi mngon dbyings na ngo bo gcig nyid de// ngo bo gcig las sprul pa stong phrag 'gyed// sprul pa re la phyag brnyan 'bum phrag re// khams gsum kun khyab lha mo'i thugs dam bskang*// ngo bo gcig la rnam pa dpon g.yog tshul// bdud kyi bu mo nag mo re ma ti// sprul pa re ti mched bzhi g.yog 'khor 'bum// ma gcig lha mo dpon g.yog thugs dam bskang*// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za nam mkha' lding*// mi'am ci dang grul bum bram ze mi// kun gyis bstod cing phyag byas mnga' gsol ba// srid gsum 'gran bral lha mo'i thugs dam bskang*// dbyings kyi khro rgyal rnam par snang mdzad de// 'gro ba'i don du sa brgyad sems mar sprul// 'jigs pa'i skur ston gdug pa kun 'dul ma// rab 'jigs khrag 'thung rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// ming brgya mtshan stong rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab// rdzu 'phrul dpag med mthu rtsal thogs pa med// dam tshig rjes gcod rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul// dam ldan lha mo dpon g.yog thugs dam bskang*// dkar ser dmar ljang zhi dang zhi ma khro// sna tshogs sku dang de bzhin sna tshogs sngags// sna tshogs phrin las dngos grub kun 'byung ba'i// yid bzhin nor mchog lha mo'i thugs dam bskang*// phyi yi gnas yul nang gi rtsa rlung khams// gsang ba rang gi sems dang dbyer med cing*// 'khor 'das kun la khyab cing dbang bsgyur pa'i// kun khyab kun bzang lha mo'i thugs dam bskang*// 'dod pa'i khams na 'dod chags las gyur pa'i// snang srid ma mo mkha' 'gro ci mchis pa// thams cad khyod kyi 'khor g.yog pho nya ste// mo rgyud ma mo yongs kyi thugs dam bskang*// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa yi// nyams chags 'gal 'khrul rtog sgrib ci mchis pa// lha mo dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas la bshags// mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal nas kyang*// yams nad rims nad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod//

ces dang*/ ma mo'i 'khrugs skong ni/ bh+yo/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la// gsang sngags bon du gyer ba'i tshe// pha zer bu yis mi nyan dus// dus ngan nye ba 'thab pa dang*// gos ngan re thul gyon pa dang*// zas ngan lci ba za ba dang*// sde 'khrugs nang dme byed pa'i dus// ma mo nag mo thugs khros nas// bud med sna tshogs stong khams gang*// mi nad phyugs nad sna tshogs gtong*// mkha' la nad sprin sna tshogs 'khrigs// dus kyi 'khrugs pa slong byed ma// mtshon gyi bskal pas 'jig byed ma// glo bur mi la lhog rgod 'bebs// thog ser 'bebs pa'i snying mo che// sa bdag klu gnyan khyod kyi 'bangs// lha srin sde brgyad khyod kyi 'khor// khyod kyis mi 'dul gang yang med// nad kyang ma mo khyod kyi nad// rims kyang ma mo khyod kyi rims// khrag kyang ma mo khyod kyi khrag /spyi bdud nad kyi kha lo sgyur// bskang ngo khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi gtor ma dang*// bsten rdzas skong rdzas sgrub rdzas kyis// 'khrugs pa'i ma mo'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskang ngo sa ma ya// thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad kha chod la rims kha sgyur// khram kha phyis la shwa rdel spos// nad gdon bar chad bsgyur du gsol// mo ngan mtsher rtsub bsgyur du gsol// pho bdud dal kha g.yas su bsgyur// mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur// spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la bsgyur// bzlog bsgyur chen po'i dus la babs// dus la babs po sa ma ya// bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// thog med dus nas ma rig dbang gyur pas// mi shes sgrib pa le lo'i dbang gis ni// thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam las 'gal ba rnams// sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod// man ngag gi yig brgya dang*/ lag g.yas mdzub mo srin lag gnyis mthil du bkug
