/mthe bong gung mo mthe'u chung gsum bsgreng ba phyar ba tri shu la'i phyag rgyas/ hūm̐ phaṭa ma hā de wī kā li duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha ru lu bhin+dha pa tsa ba ra na hūm̐ phaṭa// ces mtshan ngan bzlog go /lag gnyis sor mo bcu bsdus nas khog pa zlum po bdud rtsi bum pa'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra dhā ki nī de wī ma hā kā lī re ma ti kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi sa mā ya pha la a we sha ya āḥ bh+yo/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar thug la// ban+de bla ma'i dam tshig nyams// skye bo khrel dang ngo tsha bor// de tshe ma mo thugs khros nas// nad mug 'khrugs gsum sprin ltar g.yo// de dag khyod kyi cho 'phrul te// de phyir dam rdzas gtor bdud rtsi// brten bskang sgrub pa gsum gyi rdzas// ma mo 'khrugs pa'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i mthus// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro tshogs kyis// nad gdon bar chad bzlog tu gsol// mi mthun phyogs kun bzlog tu gsol// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bdag gzhan mi shes le lo yis// sa lam bgrod la 'gal ba rnams// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par gsol// dzam gling bde ba'i bkra shis shog / ces karma pa bcu bzhi pas so/ /rje mi la'i sgrub brgyud pa'i bstan srung lha sman mched lnga'i gsol bskang nyung bsdus ni/ hrīḥ chos dbyings rang byung kun tu bzang*// bde chen dbyings phyug rdo rje'i yum// sprul sku bstan srung mkha' 'gro lnga// gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// mched bzhi rigs 'khor sprul pa 'bum// snang srid ma mo'i dkyil 'khor rnams// gdung ba'i sems kyis 'bod lags na// thugs dam dbang gis gshegs nas kyang*// dgyes shing mnyes pa'i mdangs phyungs shig /khyed mchod phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzas// 'bod rten skong sgrub mchod pa'i sprin// rmad byung rdo rje'i longs spyod mchog /mkha' mnyam rgyas par bkang ba 'dis// gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul bshags// mchog thun dngos grub chen po stsol// kaṃ tshang bstan pa gnyan po srungs// bstan 'dzin sku tshe phrin las spel// mi mthun dus kyi rgud pa dang*// mtha' dmag nad yams rtsub 'gyur sogs// ma mo 'khrugs pa'i cho 'phrul zlog

/bdag 'khor yon bdag bu bzhin skyongs// bde skyid dpal yon gong du spel// rnal 'byor gsang ba'i grogs mdzod la// mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul nus pa spor// gzugs can gzugs med dbang du bsdus// phyi nang gsang ba'i dgra gsum sod// rtsa rlung thig le'i mdud pa khrol// bde chen ye shes mngon gyur nas// don gnyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces bskang ba'i rim pa rnams bya'o// yab yum gyi thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bdag ni dam can sgrub pa po// khyod ni chos skyong dam tshig can// bstan pa'i bka' srung rdzu 'phrul can// sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las mdzod cig /oṃ ma hā kā la kā la ya sa ma ya sid+dhi tiṣ+ṭha lhan hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bh+yo/ dus gsum kun tu ma sgrib ye shes can// ma sring chung ma bu mo bran mo'i tshogs// ye shes mngon shes mnga' ba'i thugs brtse ma// mthu rtsal rmad byung mnga' ba'i byin rlabs can// sngon gyi zhal bzhes nyid kyi dam bcas ltar// bstan pa srung phyir rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /oṃ ma ma traka rak+ṣa ru lu ru lu bh+yo dzaḥhūm̐/ de nas bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi mgon po'i thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐/ ces pas g.yas dang*/ lha mo'i thugs kar nyi steng bh+yo la/ oṃ yak+ṣa be tā li hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas g.yon du 'khor ba de las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros nas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams mchod/ de thams cad ma mgon bco brgyad du gyur/ 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas bdag mdun gnyis ka la sib sib thims par bsam bsnyen pa ci lcog byed/ de nas thun gtor 'bul bar spro na/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa yang sprul gyi tshogs lcags kyu thogs pa grangs med pa spros nas dgra bo rnams bkug ste gtor mar bstim pas dgra bgegs dngos su gyur bar bsam la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/

sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma mchog /brgyud par bcas pa thams cad dang*// lha mi'i ston pa bcom ldan 'das// rnam grol mchog sbyin chos kyi mchog /der gnas rgyal ba'i sras rnams dang*// yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// khyad par dpal ldan nag po che// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden cing*// bden pa chen po'i mthu rtsal gyis// gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs kyi// bla srog rnam shes gar gnas kyang*// rang dbang med par 'dir khug cig /badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ kā la rū pa ni ku ru ā kar+ṣa ya/ ā kar+ṣa ya/ theng ma theng ma hri/ sti ga ye/ u ni u ni la ra dza dza/ mdun bskyed mgon po'i phyag gi gri gug las hūm̐ dang lha mo'i kha ṭ+wām̐ las dzaḥ'aphros nas sna bug dang gshang lam du zhugs nas snying gar phyin pas zangs lcags kyi 'khor lo gnyis su gyur nas g.yas g.yon du drag tu 'khor bas sha rus dum bur btub par bsam la/

oṃ trag rak+ṣa dun tiṃ ma bh+yo/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la ya/ shā sa naṃ/ u pa kā ri ṇāṃ eṣā pash+tsi ma kā lo yaṃ/ duṃ duṃ rak+ṣa tshal pa ha la duṣ+ṭa sha trūṃ ta thā ru tri pi ta/ dha mi rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇī/ ya ti pra ti dz+nyā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ ma ma duṣ+ṭaṃ dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de na me ke na/ dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ e ā ral+li hoḥ shrī ma hā kā la khā hi/ traka rak+ṣa khā hi/ traka rak+ṣa dun bh+yo khā hi/ traka rak+ṣa rbad bh+yo khā hi/ dam can mgon po nag po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs su gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di 'bul lo// bzhes su gsol khā hi/ ma ma snying khrag tshal pa dun tiṃ ha la duṃ bh+yo/ gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma'i sha khrag la kha raṃ khā hi/ ༈ mgon po'i dgra chos shin tu bsdus pa dam can dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba ni/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa gsol bar bsam la/ hūm̐/ mthar byed gdong lnga'i dbyangs kyi nga ro ni// mi bsrun drag por khros pa'i gzugs 'chang ba// rdo rje srin po ma hā kā la che// bka' 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la// chil chil rnam par mi bsrun dus kyi rnga// khrag zhag bdud rtsi'i dga' ba 'thor ba'i rgyun// rab 'byams khyon kun 'gengs pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs// ma lus rnam dag blo yis sprul nas kyang*// rmad byung bstod pa'i dbyangs kyi dgyes bskang bas// sa gsum phan bde'i 'dod 'jo dpag bsam shing*// rgyal bstan zla dkar bsil ba'i rnga g.yab ni// srid gsum duḥkha'i mun pa sel slad du// bsod nams kun gsal yangs por rtag 'char zhing*// de 'dzin thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron me rnams// rab brtan mtshan bzang nyin byed snang ba'i zer// g.yo med gdul bya'i pad+mau+o 'dzum slad du// zhabs sen rdo rje'i phreng bas mdzes gyur cig

/'dus tshogs ma dros rlabs 'phreng 'thor ba'i rgyun// ngur smrig bslab gsum mtshon gyis bgos pa yi// bsod nams zhing gi yon tan sprin dkar mdzes// thar pa'i sbrang char sil mas khyab par mdzod// gtums shing mi bsrun spyod pa'i drag shul can// yid bsrubs snying la nyal ba'i dpung gi tshogs// don dam sems kyi rdo rje'i me lce yis// kun rtog zhen 'dzin nags tshal sreg par mdzod// mtha' yas skye rgu mar gyur 'gro ba'i tshogs// gzhan phan rgyal sras spyod pa'i dbyangs snyan gyis// 'tshe med dwang ba 'dren pa'i dga' ston la// nub med spyod pa'i dge legs 'bar gyur cig// / ces pa 'di mgon pa gang nyid kyi mtshan bzang gi bdud rtsi snang ba'i go skabs su thob pa'i skal bzang can o rgyan phrin las rdo rje zhes bod yul nas mched pa'i btsan byol ba rdzab chen nor skyong ltar rgyu ba des dmar phyogs mtshur zla dang po'i tshes nyer dgur rgyud stod rwa mo che'i gtsug lag khang du smon pa dge legs 'phel// de nas drag tu rbad cing phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ gang zhig bla ma la smod chos la sdang*// 'gro la rnam 'tshe sgrub pa po la gnod// ngan 'gror nyer gzhol de dag rnams kyi srog /zangs gri 'bar bas yud kyis gcod par mdzod// gang du rdo rje'i ser chen dbab pa'am// bskal me 'bar dang drag po'i rlung shugs sogs// 'jigs chen brgya phrag du ma'i cho 'phrul dang*// ltas ngan mtshan ma bye ba dbab par mdzod// shin tu mi bzad nad gdon 'bum phrag gis// dgra bo bu dang chung ma 'bangs bcas kun// skad cig nyid la bsad de bskal stong du// mnan gzer bskrad dang rengs pa'i phrin las mdzod// mi bsrun sha za'i pho nya dung phyur yang*// khros pa'i mig bgrad khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rno ba'i mtshon thogs rngam pa'i nga ro 'byin// rings par rgyug byed khyod kyi dus la bab// nam mkha' gang ba 'dab bzang dbang po'i tshogs// gdong lnga la sogs gcan gzan ma rungs pa// bye ba dung phyur khri phrag du ma rnams// nyams pa 'di yi sha rus khrag la rol// bh+yo/

ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro mgon skyob pa rnams kyi bka' bzhin du// phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i bka' nyan ma// rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan zhing ma thogs par// phrin las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i las mdzod cig /dper na rngon pas ri dwags bshor ba bzhin// gsod pa don du gnyer ba'i las mdzad mas// bsad pa don du gnyer ba'i las mdzod cig /oṃ e ā ral+li hoḥ shrī ma hā kā la khā hi/ trag rak+ṣa khā hi/ trag rak+ṣa dun bh+yo khā hi/ trag rak+ṣa rbad bh+yo khā hi/ dam can mgon po nag po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs su gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di 'bul lo// bzhes su gsol khā hi/ ces brjod nas thun gtor zor du byed pa'am rang bzhin 'bul ba skabs dang bstun/ bzlog pa bya na lo tri pa la'am/ yang na/ oṃ hūm̐ trig khroṃ bh+yo: ma ni mā ra ni bh+yo: ma ra dun bh+yo: rak+mo rak+ṣa ni/ ting ya rak+ṣa bh+yo: dgra bgegs byad ma mā ra ya/ ya ma rā dza ki la ya bh+yoḥ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi= bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i= yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi= mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi= sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i= khyad par du 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi= rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i= sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa la brten nas/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la chag che ba/ nyam nga ba/ rmi lam ngan pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ pha rol gyi rmis ltas/ rbod gtong rbad 'dre/ byad kha zor kha phur kha gtad kha/ khyad par du bzlog pa byed pa'i mthu dang nus pa thams cad zlog mkhan byad ma kho rang gi steng du zlog cig

/rang gshed rang la phob cig /rang srog rang gis chod cig /rang sha rang gis zo shig /rang khrag rang gis 'thungs shig /kho rang gi lha srung thams cad kho rang gi gshed du phob cig /bdag gi chos skyong thams cad kho'i gshed du phog cig /mā ra ya zlog zlog bh+yo bh+yo/ zhes thal mo brdab/ 'jam dpal bden pa'i dmod pa yis// dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad kyi// lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol// khyod kyi rigs sngags bzlas pa'i mthus// gnod byed ma lus zhi ba dang*// ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i na bza'i sul rnams nas rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char dang*/ gzhan yang gnas gsum nas ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub sku gzugs/ snying po/ phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa sogs 'phros nas rang nyid la thim par dmigs la/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs nas kyang*// byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol// nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// sras mchog nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs// 'dir gshegs bdag la = byin gyis rlabs par = ri rab mchog gi steng shed nas// 'jig rten mgon po gzi brjid can// 'dir gshegs bdag la= byin gyis rlabs par= mthong ba tsam gyis bdud kyi dpung*// kun nas skrag par byed pa yi// ma hā kā la khyod kyi zhal// bdag la de ring bstan du gsol// las bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad// skad cig yud kyis 'grub byed pa// sngags kyi dngos grub chen po de'ang*// bdag la de ring stsal du gsol// byams pa'i thugs kyis bdag la dgongs// brtse ba'i spyan gyis bdag la gzigs// lung bstan rjes su gnang ba yi// bka' stsal bdag la gnang du gsol// mdun bskyed lha mo'i gnas gsum gyi 'od zer gsum gyi tshogs spros pa'i rtse mo nas re ma ti mched gsum gyi tshogs spros nas srid pa gsum gyi bcud thams cad bsdus nas rang la bstims par bsam la/

bh+yo/ ma gcig smin mtshams mdzod spu yi// 'od zer gyi ni drwa ba las// sku yi sprul pa grangs med 'gyed// dpal ldan lha mo re ma dza/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// ma gcig ljags kyi dbang po yi// 'od zer gyi ni drwa ba las// gsung gi sprul pa grangs med 'gyed// dpal ldan lha mo re ma dzu// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// ma gcig thugs kyi dpal be'u yi// 'od zer gyi ni drwa ba las// thugs kyi sprul pa grangs med 'gyed// dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la re ma ti sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ khrag gi rgya mtsho me tog u pāk+ṣa// tshil chen bsreg dang mar nag chen po'i me// thal chen khrag zhag bdud rtsi sha chen lnga// dur khrod sgra yis phyogs rnams bkang ste 'bul// oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la de wī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe a lo ke ghan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ bar gyis mchod cing*/ hūm̐/ ḍā ki bye ba 'bum gyis rab btud cing*// bcom ldan rdo rje bde mas yang dag 'khyud// bde chen lhun 'grub mi phyed go 'phang brnyes// rgyal ba kun yab khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// ces dang*/ oṃ sa ma ya/ āḥs ma ya/ hūm̐ sa ma ya/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la yak+ṣa be ta li hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/

a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shri yaḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wā na/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+rī bhā wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ tshe rabs kun nas rgyal bas dbang bskur cing*// tshe rabs kun tu bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i// mgon po mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo ā kri ni/ na mo yo tri ni/ na mo ta kri ni/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hi li hi li/ ki ti tsi ti/ ni ti pa ta ye swā hā/ tshe rabs sngon nas da lta phan chad du// rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung bar dam bcas pa// da lta deng 'dir bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor dang bcas pa yi// phyi nang bar chad thams cad zhi bar shog /bdag ni mngon par byang chub ste// rang rig ye shes mngon gyur nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung slad du// khyod dang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid pa// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong srung ma 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /oṃ/ dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'dir yang bkra shis shing*// nyin yang bkra shis dpal 'bar ta la la// mtshan yang bkra shis dpal 'bar kyi li li// nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog /maṅga laṃ sid+dhi dzaḥya a la la ho// ces brjod cing bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// //
